name: Supra Vandal
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk
conditions: Forma blueprints can't be sold for Ducats; pick relics whose uncommon slot isn't Forma.
Only sell duplicates and parts from Primes you've already built or mastered.
bonuses: Short Capture and Exterminate fissures in a full squad give four rewards to pick from, raising the odds of a 100-Ducat rare.
Refining relics to Radiant with banked Void Traces raises the rare odds.

disclosures.title: the Ducat rate
disclosures.body: One long-term player measured about 40-50 Ducats per relic run and about 1,200 Ducats an hour with fast Captures and Exterminates, so 500 is well under an hour. The Kiosks are open between visits, so stockpile rather than scrambling during Baro's 48 hours.

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for 48 hours; stock rotates

rows.label: Supra Vandal
rows.note: arrives built, no blueprint or foundry step

conditions: Baro only brings it on some visits, a few times a year; if he doesn't have it, wait for a later visit.
Keep a free primary weapon slot ready.
MR 14 to equip, so it gives no Mastery until then.

disclosures.title: TennoCon Relay
disclosures.body: Baro's once-a-year TennoCon Relay stocks everything he has ever sold, including this, but entry needs Baro's Relay Ticket from the paid TennoCon Digital Pack.
